title: ✅ MEMBER MONTHLY MEETING EVERY 1ST TUESDAY
summary: All members are encouraged to attend. Meetings begin at 7:00 PM at the clubhouse.
fullContent:
Monthly membership meetings occur on the first Tuesday of every month at 7:00 PM at the main clubhouse.

Agenda topics include facility upgrades, upcoming event planning, financial reports, and new member introductions. All active members are encouraged to participate and contribute to ongoing club initiatives.

title: ⚠️ UPCOMING HUNTER SAFETY CLASS: AUG 22–23
summary: DNR-certified Hunter Safety Course held at the clubhouse. Pre-registration is required. Click for details!
fullContent:
Sterling Sportsmen Association Hunter Safety Certification Course

Dates: Saturday, August 22 & Sunday, August 23, 2026
Location: Main Clubhouse & Outdoor Range

This state-certified course is mandatory for first-time hunters born after January 1, 1960. Certified DNR instructors will cover essential topics including:
• Safe firearm handling and field safety
• Wildlife conservation & hunter ethics
• Bowhunting fundamentals and tree-stand safety
• First aid and outdoor survival skills

Requirements: Students must attend both days and pass the written exam and live field walkthrough to receive their certification card. Lunch will be provided on Saturday.
